items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Just like Earl Warren used to bring a group over there quite often

ctx.x: Well, how often do you do it?

Well, off and on, say, like would come to public relations, they called me and said, Caldwell, want you to get a group to go over there and go on our to South Campus and do a solo. They're advertising in the college paper. Just like Earl Warren used to bring a group over there quite often, Dizzy Gillespie and different ones. I mean that's where most of your musicians are now, like Fordham University, CCNY, NYU. They have all these little jazz seminars.
Well, what do you do at those seminars?
